lastSay: d63: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Jinlong Liang is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d63: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d63: 🕯️ Jinlong Liang is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d63: What Jinlong kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d63: No one is left to pick up the Codex. The village dies out — quietly, the way villages do. The season ends here.
